llms.body:
# Wego

> Wego is a travel marketplace for flights and hotels. AI agents use the surfaces below.

## For AI agents

- [Wego MCP server](https://mcp.wego.com/public-app/v1/mcp): live flight and hotel search over MCP (streamable HTTP)
- [Wego for AI agents](https://agents.wego.com): Claude connector, ChatGPT plugin, CLI and agent skill
- [Agent docs index](https://agents.wego.com/llms.txt)
- [OpenAPI contract](https://api.wego.com/openapi)
